# Physics Exam Prep

Not a generated static site and not an asset dump: a **hand-written, zero-dependency, offline-first
single-page web app** — an installable PWA — built from one Physics course's own 106-slide deck
(F. Peña-Benítez, `04ITE0-25S301O01903W`) and enriched with OpenStax *University Physics Vol 3*.
One of four instances of [[course-as-runnable-study-tool]].

**Status: coursework, finished and frozen at last commit 2026-07-10.** "All finished and frozen"
(interview, 2026-07-28).

## What it contains

29 topics across 4 modules · 13 canvas simulators · 82 Leitner flashcards
([[spaced-repetition-leitner-boxes]]) · a 75-question quiz bank · 3 generated study sets
([[jaccard-similarity-set-selection]]) · the 30-question scanned exam transcribed with worked
step-by-step solutions · a progress dashboard · a 6/7-hour study plan · a printable cheat sheet.

## There is no build system, and that is the point

No `package.json` anywhere in the repo. No SSG config, no bundler, no CI workflow, no output
directory. `exam_prep/index.html` is a hand-authored 5.6 KB shell with five `<script>` tags;
routing is hash-based vanilla JS in `js/app.js`; `sw.js` is hand-written. See
[[zero-dependency-no-build-step]] and [[offline-first-static-deliverable]].

The **only** vendored dependency is [[katex]] — CSS, JS and 20 `.woff2` files copied locally so no
CDN is ever contacted. That is a deliberate choice with a rejected alternative:
[[vendor-katex-instead-of-cdn]]. The bulk of the repo's bytes are therefore *content* (36 lecture
and textbook diagrams, 5 animations) plus math fonts — not build residue.

| File | Size | Is |
|---|---|---|
| `js/data.js` | 101 KB | the knowledge base — topics, formulas, flashcards, quiz bank, plan |
| `js/app.js` | 47 KB | the SPA — routing, flashcards, quiz, dashboard, timer, search |
| `js/teach.js` | 47 KB | the "Feynman layer" — intuition, analogies, 40 self-checks, 13 predict-first prompts |
| `js/sims.js` | 39 KB | the canvas simulators |
| `js/quizsets.js` | 23 KB | **generated** by `tools/build_sets.mjs` |
| `tools/build_sets.mjs` | 31 KB | Jaccard set builder + auditor, Node-only |
| `tools/qa.mjs` | 14.9 KB | hand-rolled static-check harness, Node-only |

Both `.mjs` tools load the browser's `data.js` by executing it into a fake window
(`new Function("window", code)(win)`) instead of converting it to an ES module — the global-script
shape is preserved on purpose so the browser needs no module system. `tools/` is never shipped.

`localStorage` progress is keyed `physprep.v1` — the same invalidation idea as the
`STORAGE_VERSION` counter used by the sibling apps in [[course-as-runnable-study-tool]], expressed
as a versioned key rather than an integer.

## The tooling is real, and it audits itself

`tools/build_sets.mjs` emits both `js/quizsets.js` and a committed `tools/AUDIT.md` sanity report —
[[generated-audit-artifact]]. `tools/qa.mjs` runs static integrity checks including check 8,
"Service worker precache vs index.html", which fails if any asset `index.html` loads is missing
from the service worker's `CORE` list. That check exists because it caught a real offline bug; the
fix is recorded as [[cache-individually-not-addall]].

What none of it checks is **subject-matter correctness**: the README claims the Bohr simulator
reproduces the Balmer lines at 656 / 486 / 434 / 410 nm, but `qa.mjs` validates ids, asset paths,
KaTeX parsing and precache coverage — never numerical output. See
[[provenance-and-limits-stated-inline]].

## Findings

- **The app was built outside version control.** File mtimes run 2026-06-27 (`vendor/katex`) to
  2026-06-30 (`js/*`), ten days before the first commit on 2026-07-10 — seven commits in two
  clusters, the second being the licence/badge pair shared with [[computer-project-management]] and
  [[privacy-policy-template]]. [[import-finished-work-into-git]] with mtime proof.
- **These are also the earliest in-repo timestamps of the whole exam-prep family.** The interview
  names [[it-applications-in-business-and-commerce]] as the origin of the lineage and that answer is
  authoritative; the mtime tension is argued out once on
  [[course-as-runnable-study-tool]] and is not re-litigated here.
- **[[documentation-drift]], four independent instances** — the densest concentration in the source
  set, all of them the docs falling behind the code:
  | Claim | `README.md` | `snapshot.md` | The code / generated output |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | service-worker cache version | `physprep-v2` | `physprep-v3` | `physprep-v4` in `sw.js` |
  | simulators in `sims.js` | 9 (structure block) / 13 (feature table) | 13 | — |
  | `qa.mjs` static checks | 32 | 34 | — |
  | quiz bank size | — | 75 | `build_sets.mjs` header says 62; `AUDIT.md` reports 75 |
- **A claimed test harness that is not in the tree.** `exam_prep/README.md` states "A headless DOM
  smoke test additionally renders all 40 routes without a runtime error". `tools/` contains only
  `build_sets.mjs` and `qa.mjs`. `confidence: high` on the absence.
